feeds.title: Recipe Tin Eats » Low Calorie Recipes
feeds.description: I believe you can make great food with everyday ingredients even if you're short on time and cost-conscious. You just need to cook cleverly and get creative! These Low-Calorie Recipes prove you can eat healthy, nutritious meals with less than 500 calories per serving for a complete meal and there's no skimping owns serving sizes!

feeds.title: Fasting At Home » Low Fat Recipes
feeds.description: The Feasting At Home blog's low-fat recipe category features a wide variety of healthy and delicious recipes that are low in fat. Whether you're looking for a quick and easy meal or a more elaborate dish, you're sure to find something to your liking in this category. With recipes for everything from chicken stroganoff to sweet potato and lentil curry, there's something for everyone in the low-fat recipe category at Feasting At Home.

feeds.title: Low Fat For Life
feeds.description: I had to eat differently, that meant I also had to cook differently. I started sharing the recipes I created and they became very well received. My passion for cooking grew. If there was a dish that I wanted that I could no longer eat, I made it my mission to recreate it. And this blog is all about that.

feeds.title: Skinny Fitalicious Blog
feeds.description: Enter the world of balanced nutrition and weight loss guidance with Skinny Fitalicious, curated by Megan, a seasoned nutrition practitioner and author. Through her platform, Megan shares low-calorie recipes and weight-loss tips tailored for women over 35, drawing from her transformative journey of shedding 80 pounds. As host of the 'Dish On Ditching Diets' podcast and author of the Low-Calorie Cookbook, Megan empowers individuals to reclaim their health by balancing hormones and adopting sustainable dietary practices.

feeds.title: Motive8 Blog » Low Fat Recipe
feeds.description: We also offer corporate well-being and fitness sessions. motive8 North is part of motive8 Group Ltd. You've heard it before, 'abs are made in the kitchen, '80% of your success is your diet'. We're here to give you as much nutritional support as you need through food diaries and meal plan recommendations.

feeds.title: Skinny Comfort
feeds.description: Learn how to make 'skinny' comfort food with simple and easy recipes! By cooking at home and swapping for healthier ingredients, you can cut calories without sacrificing taste! Skinny Comfort recipes are delicious healthy meals that your entire family will enjoy. Learn how to make lighter comfort food with simple and easy recipes! Substitute healthier ingredients to save calories without sacrificing taste!
